desc: Offline architecture spike unlocked by ticket 174. Design m1n1 chainload= stage-2 loading from internal NVMe without touching the rig: fixed on-disk location or GPT selection, maximum size and alignment, streaming SHA-256/authenticity policy, rollback/fallback behavior, torn-update handling, memory placement, cache/DMA ownership, shutdown handoff and failure telemetry. Threat-model corrupt or malicious disk contents and fail closed before execution. Produce an implementation plan and host-side tests only; no disk reads/writes, no new proxy opcode, no candidate run, no enrollment and no external posting.
